info.title: Gym Tracker Log
info.description: Fetches the user's current workout log from their Gym Tracker app's cloud backup.

get.summary: Get the user's full workout log
get.description: Returns the complete gym log as JSON: sessions keyed by ISO date, each with a day type (push/pull) and per-exercise arrays of sets, where each set is {r: reps, kg: weight-or-null-for-bodyweight}.
